events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Kauai, HI
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...The island of Kauai in Kauai County...

* WHEN...Until 945 PM HST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding on roads, poor drainage areas, and in
streams.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 732 PM HST, Doppler radar indicated bands of moderate to
locally heavy rain over Kauai. The heaviest rainfall has been
occurring over southern coast of Kauai with rates of 0.5 to 1
inch per hour under the heavier bands. Minor flooding is ongoing
or expected to begin shortly in the advisory area. Additional
bands of heavy rain with increased rain rates will be possible
over the next several hours.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Lihue, Kapaa, Kalaheo, Kekaha, Lawai, Omao, Kokee State Park and
Poipu.

events.region: Sumter; Pinellas; Coastal Citrus; Coastal Hernando; Coastal Pasco; Coastal Hillsborough; Coastal Manatee; Inland Citrus; Inland Hernando; Inland Pasco; Inland Hillsborough; Inland Manatee
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is possible.

* WHERE...A portion of west central Florida, including the following
areas, Coastal Citrus, Coastal Hernando, Coastal Hillsborough,
Coastal Manatee, Coastal Pasco, Inland Citrus, Inland Hernando,
Inland Hillsborough, Inland Manatee, Inland Pasco, Pinellas and
Sumter.

* WHEN...From 5 AM EDT early this morning through this evening.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Flooding may occur in poor drainage and urban areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- A frontal boundary across the central Florida peninsula will lift
slowly north today.  Deep tropical moisture remains over the
region.  Numerous to widespread showers and scattered
thunderstorms are expected throughout the day with locally heavy
rain likely.  Rainfall totals of 1 to 3 inches with locally 5+
inches will be possible.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
